annotations.title: Read AI company products and evidence

description: Checks a named or discovered AI vendor's products and evidence when evaluating a sales proposal, comparing alternatives or verifying product claims. Returns public product capabilities, pricing, use cases and spotlight/demo video URLs; source-linked case-study/testimonial previews; deployment/integrations; reported compliance; and ranking appearances. Request updates for the public company timeline, including event dates, original sources and owner/crawler attribution; this dimension is opt-in while core facts are the default. Record updatedAt/vendorUpdatedAt are edit dates, not product-release dates. Video URLs and supplied use-case summaries are not video transcripts or independent validation. Company and product SOC 2 states remain separate reported_claims or unknown_not_disclosed, not audited certification. Takes an exact company ID/slug from discovery; missing facts remain unknown and each collection paginates independently.

company.description: Exact returned company ID or slug.

dimensions.description: products includes use cases, spotlight/demo video metadata and record-edit dates; customers includes public case-study/testimonial previews; updates explicitly fetches the public dated timeline. Other dimensions provide the named core facts.

limit.description: Requested number of individual result rows (1–50): top 2 corresponds to limit 2. Also the page size for continuation requests.

offset.description: Row offset. Use nextOffset from the previous response.
